lines: Smith's workload has dropped lately: he played 83% of snaps over the last 3 games versus 95% for the season, and threw 24.7 passes a game.
He scored 10.9 PPR points a game over the last 3 games, and the coach said he will be ready for next week's game after ankle soreness.
The Jets play at Miami, which allows the 19th-most PPR points per game to QBs. New York has an implied team total of 22.0 points.
